steps.text: I found the height issue: the finger pads sit about 4–5 cm below the TCP, so the earlier grasp closed above the handle. Lowering the TCP to about 0.04 m let the pads close around it, and the hammer followed on lift. I’m now carrying it above the nail and will drive the head downward while checking nail displacement.

steps.text: Slow horizontal motion kept the hammer attached; the previous faster transfer had dropped it. The first strike grazed the nail but did not drive it. The image shows the hammer head extends toward −X from the handle root, so I’m shifting the root about 8 cm past the nail in +X before the next downward strike.
